remarks: An exceptional opportunity on a rare, expansive property in coveted Greenwich, presenting a unique choice to renovate or custom-build. The home offers timeless character, light-filled interiors & is ready for a transformation to suit your vision. The main level boasts a living room, formal dining room, and a spacious kitchen adjoining the family room. Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms provide comfort & versatility, while the expansive unfinished lower level offers endless possibilities. Outside, tranquil grounds create a private retreat with lush landscaping and space to relax or entertain. Whether you choose to renovate or build, this property presents unmatched potential in one of Connecticut's most desirable communities. Don't miss this opportunity!
